name: Querzy — AI Shop Assistant for WooCommerce
author: Querzy

sections.description:
Let AI answer your customers’ product questions.

Your store already has the information, but customers still ask: “Do you have this under €100?”, “Which one is better for beginners?”. Querzy adds a chat bubble to your store that answers with real products from your own catalog: product cards with picture, price and a link to buy. Day and night.

This plugin connects your store to the Querzy service (querzy.com). A paid Querzy plan is required, with a 7-day free trial (card required). See “Pricing” and “External services” below.

What your store gets

  • Answers from your own catalog. Querzy finds matching products and shows them as cards with image, price and link.
  • Help choosing. Customers can compare products and narrow down their choice in a normal conversation.
  • Your shoppers’ language. Querzy replies in the language the customer writes in, including Macedonian, Serbian, Croatian, Bulgarian, Greek, Albanian and English.
  • Your catalog stays current. When you add, edit or delete a product, and once a day, the plugin sends the update to Querzy automatically.
  • See what customers ask. Your Querzy dashboard shows the conversations and which questions found no products.
  • Light on your store. One script, loaded with defer. No jQuery.

How it works

  1. Create your Querzy account at querzy.com and start your 7-day free trial.
  2. Add your store and choose WooCommerce. Querzy shows you two keys: a Widget Key and a Sync Key.
  3. Paste these two keys in WordPress under Settings → Querzy and click Save Settings. Your products are sent to Querzy and the chat bubble appears on your store.

No product feed to set up and no theme editing.

Watch the 2-minute setup video:

Pricing

All plans start with a 7-day free trial. A card is required to start it, and you are not charged during the 7 days. After the trial, the plan renews monthly unless you cancel. Cancel anytime from your billing portal.

  • Starter, $19/month: 1 store, up to 500 products, 500 AI answers per month
  • Growth, $49/month: up to 3 stores, 5,000 products, 2,000 AI answers per month, full widget customisation
  • Pro, $99/month: up to 5 stores, unlimited products, 5,000 AI answers per month
  • Enterprise: larger catalogues and custom setups, on request

Current prices and currencies: https://querzy.com/pricing

An AI answer is one shopper question answered by the assistant. At 80% of your allowance we tell you. At 100% the chat keeps running on 20% extra for the rest of the month.

External services

This plugin connects to Querzy (https://querzy.com), the service that runs the shop assistant. It sends nothing until you enter your Querzy keys.

  • Product sync: when you save your Sync Key, click Sync now, change a product, and once a day, the plugin sends your published products (name, price, description, categories, image link and similar product fields) and a short sync report to Querzy.
  • Chat: the chat script loads from querzy.com on your store. The messages a shopper types are sent to Querzy so it can answer them.
  • Bot protection: the chat uses Cloudflare Turnstile (https://challenges.cloudflare.com) to block automated abuse. Cloudflare privacy policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

No customer accounts, orders or addresses are sent. The full list of the data we process and the providers we use is in the Querzy Privacy Policy, and we send it to you on request at support@querzy.com.

Querzy Terms of Service: https://querzy.com/terms
Querzy Privacy Policy: https://querzy.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New, search for Querzy, click Install Now, then Activate. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Sign up at https://querzy.com/signup and start your free trial.
  3. In your Querzy account, add your store and choose WooCommerce. Use exactly the store address shown on the plugin’s settings page. Copy the Widget Key and the Sync Key.
  4. In WordPress, open Settings → Querzy. Paste each key into the field with the same name and click Save Settings. Your products are sent right away.
  5. Open your store and click the chat bubble to try it.

Lost your keys? You can create new ones in your Querzy account. Keep the Sync Key private.

Step-by-step video of the whole setup: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ISDm4TTETjc
sections.faq:
Which languages does it support?

The assistant answers in the language the shopper writes in, across 100+ languages, including Macedonian, Serbian, Croatian, Bulgarian, Greek and Albanian. The plugin’s settings page is in English.

How many products can I have?

Starter covers up to 500 products, Growth up to 5,000, Pro has no product limit. If your store has more products than your plan allows, the chat keeps running with the products already imported. The settings page tells you how many were left out, and you can upgrade in your Querzy account.

Which products are sent?

Published products that are visible in your shop or search. Products hidden from the catalog, drafts, private and password-protected products are not sent.

Will it slow down my store?

The chat loads from one script tag with the defer attribute, after your page content, and needs no jQuery. Product sync runs in the background through WP-Cron, not while customers browse.

What data leaves my site?

Product data (see External services) and the messages shoppers type into the chat. No customer accounts, orders, emails or addresses are sent by the plugin.

What happens if I cancel?

Your subscription ends at the next billing date. After that the assistant stops answering on your store. Deactivate and delete the plugin to remove it completely; deleting it also removes its settings and keys from your WordPress.

What are the two keys?

The Widget Key shows the chat on your store and is visible in your page source; that is expected. The Sync Key sends your products to Querzy. Keep it private. The plugin refuses a key pasted into the wrong field.

Does it work with my theme?

The chat is a floating bubble added on top of your pages. It does not change your theme’s templates. If something looks wrong on your theme, email support@querzy.com.

I need help

Email support@querzy.com. On the settings page, open “Show technical details” and paste that block into your email.
sections.changelog:
2.5.3

  • The “Settings saved.” notice no longer appears twice after saving.

2.5.2

  • New settings page: three clear steps, the exact store address to use, and a status line that says where you stand.
  • Saving a new Sync Key starts the first product sync right away.
  • Products also sync once a day, and when a product variation changes.
  • Products hidden from your shop or search, and password-protected products, are no longer sent.
  • Smaller, faster syncs: plain-text descriptions only, long texts trimmed.
  • Clear messages when a sync fails: wrong key, key for a different store address, too many syncs, catalog too large.
  • The settings page shows how many products Querzy actually imported, and how many your plan’s product limit left out.
  • Products include your store currency, so prices show correctly in the chat.
  • Safer keys: a Sync Key pasted into the Widget Key field is refused, the Sync Key is never shown back on the page, and browsers no longer offer to fill it with a saved password.
  • Deleting the plugin now removes its settings and keys.

2.5.1 – 2026-08-16

  • The chat widget now marks itself as coming from this plugin in your Querzy analytics.

2.5.0 – 2026-07-29

  • Product sync now sends your catalog a page at a time. Fixes sync failing on large catalogs.
  • An interrupted sync no longer blocks “Sync now”. It recovers automatically.

2.4.0 – 2026-07-26

  • Added a separate Sync Key for product sync. The Widget Key no longer has catalog-write access. Get your Sync Key from your Querzy account and enter it in Settings → Querzy.

2.3.0 – 2026-07-25

  • Added Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection to the chat widget.
  • The service address is fixed to querzy.com.

2.2.0 – 2026-07-23

  • Simpler settings page and plain-language sync status.

2.1.0 – 2026-06-10

  • Store domain filled in automatically.

2.0.0 – 2026-06-05

  • Answers stream word by word. Automatic product sync. No jQuery.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
